def process(iris_full) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = iris_full.copy()
    df['petal_area'] = df['PetalLengthCm'] * df['PetalWidthCm']
    df['petal_z'] = (df['petal_area'] - df['petal_area'].mean()) / df['petal_area'].std()
    return df[['Id', 'Species', 'petal_area', 'petal_z']]

def process(iris_zscore, movies_subset) -> pd.DataFrame:
    return iris_zscore.merge(movies_subset, on='Id', how='inner')[['Id', 'Species', 'petal_z', 'title', 'vote_average']]
